tools.title: Get Annotated Message Tool

tools.name: get-env
tools.title: Print Environment Tool
tools.description: Returns all environment variables, helpful for debugging MCP server configuration

tools.name: get-header-params
tools.title: Get Header Params Tool
tools.description: Returns its region argument and the Mcp-Param-Region HTTP header it arrived in. Demonstrates x-mcp-header (a 2026-07-28 Streamable HTTP client mirrors the argument into the header) and JSON Schema 2020-12 input and output schemas.

region.description: A region name, e.g. eu-west. Mirrored into the Mcp-Param-Region HTTP header.

repeat.description: How many times to repeat the region in the result (1-3)

tools.name: get-resource-links
tools.title: Get Resource Links Tool
tools.description: Returns up to ten resource links that reference different types of resources

count.description: Number of resource links to return (1-10)

tools.name: get-resource-reference
tools.title: Get Resource Reference Tool
tools.description: Returns a resource reference that can be used by MCP clients

resourceId.description: ID of the text resource to fetch

tools.name: get-roots-list
tools.title: Get Roots List Tool
tools.description: Lists the current MCP roots provided by the client. Demonstrates the roots protocol capability even though this server doesn't access files. Deprecated: Roots is deprecated as of protocol version 2026-07-28. The server asks for the roots with a multi-round-trip request on every protocol version.

tools.name: get-structured-content
tools.title: Get Structured Content Tool
tools.description: Returns structured content along with an output schema for client data validation

tools.name: get-sum
tools.title: Get Sum Tool
tools.description: Returns the sum of two numbers

tools.name: get-tiny-image
tools.title: Get Tiny Image Tool
tools.description: Returns a tiny MCP logo image.

tools.name: gzip-file-as-resource
tools.title: GZip File as Resource Tool
tools.description: Compresses a single file using gzip compression. Depending upon the selected output type, returns either the compressed data as a gzipped resource or a resource link, allowing it to be downloaded in a subsequent request: during the current session for a 2025-era client, or for ten minutes at a minted URI on protocol version 2026-07-28.

name.description: Name of the output file (at most 255 characters)

data.description: URL or data URI of the file content to compress

outputType.description: How the resulting gzipped file should be returned. 'resourceLink' returns a link to a resource that can be read later, 'resource' returns a full resource object.

tools.name: simulate-research-query
tools.title: Simulate Research Query
tools.description: Simulates a deep research operation that gathers, analyzes, and synthesizes information. Runs as a task on the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension (protocol version 2026-07-28): the call returns a task handle, and the client polls tasks/get as the task moves through four stages. If 'ambiguous' is true and the client supports elicitation, the task pauses with status input_required until the client answers its clarification request with tasks/update.

topic.description: The research topic to investigate (at most 1,000 characters; the task keeps it until it expires)

ambiguous.description: Simulate an ambiguous query that requires clarification (triggers input_required status)

tools.name: toggle-simulated-logging
tools.title: Toggle Simulated Logging
tools.description: Toggles simulated, random-leveled logging on or off. Deprecated: 2025-era clients only, since protocol version 2026-07-28 removes logging/setLevel; use trigger-log-messages with a per-request log level instead.

tools.name: toggle-subscriber-updates
tools.title: Toggle Subscriber Updates
tools.description: Toggles simulated resource subscription updates on or off. Deprecated: 2025-era clients only, since protocol version 2026-07-28 removes resources/subscribe; use trigger-resource-update with a subscriptions/listen stream instead.

tools.name: trigger-elicitation-request-async
tools.title: Trigger Async Elicitation Request Tool
tools.description: Runs as a task on the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension (protocol version 2026-07-28) that needs the user's input: the task waits in status input_required, carrying an elicitation request, until the client answers it with tasks/update, then completes with a summary of the answer.

tools.name: trigger-elicitation-request
tools.title: Trigger Elicitation Request Tool
tools.description: Trigger a Request from the Server for User Elicitation

tools.name: trigger-list-changed
tools.title: Trigger List Changed Tool
tools.description: Sends a notifications/<list>/list_changed for the tool, prompt or resource list. On protocol version 2026-07-28 it is delivered on each subscriptions/listen stream that asked for that list; a 2025-era client receives it unsolicited.

list.description: Which list to announce as changed

tools.name: trigger-log-messages
tools.title: Trigger Log Messages Tool
tools.description: Sends one log message at each logging level during the call. On protocol version 2026-07-28 only the messages at or above the level the request names in _meta (io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel) are sent, and none if it names no level; a 2025-era client gets those at or above the level it set with logging/setLevel. Deprecated: logging is deprecated as of protocol version 2026-07-28.

tools.name: trigger-long-running-operation
tools.title: Trigger Long Running Operation Tool
tools.description: Demonstrates a long running operation with progress updates.

duration.description: Duration of the operation in seconds

steps.description: Number of steps in the operation

tools.name: trigger-multi-step-elicitation
tools.title: Trigger Multi-Step Elicitation Tool
tools.description: Asks the user for their name, then for a favorite color addressed to them by that name, carrying the first answer to the second round in requestState. Demonstrates multi-round-trip requests (input_required) and requestState on protocol version 2026-07-28; 2025-era clients get the same flow as elicitation requests.

tools.name: trigger-resource-update
tools.title: Trigger Resource Update Tool
tools.description: Sends a notifications/resources/updated for a resource URI. On protocol version 2026-07-28 it is delivered on each subscriptions/listen stream whose resourceSubscriptions name the URI; a 2025-era client receives it once it has called resources/subscribe for the URI.

uri.description: The URI of the resource to announce as updated, e.g. demo://resource/dynamic/text/1

tools.name: trigger-sampling-request-async
tools.title: Trigger Async Sampling Request Tool
tools.description: Runs as a task on the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension (protocol version 2026-07-28) that needs an LLM completion: the task waits in status input_required, carrying a sampling request, until the client answers it with tasks/update, then completes with the result. Deprecated: Sampling is deprecated as of protocol version 2026-07-28.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the LLM (at most 10,000 characters; the task keeps it until it expires)

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

tools.name: trigger-sampling-request
tools.title: Trigger Sampling Request Tool
tools.description: Trigger a Request from the Server for LLM Sampling. Deprecated: Sampling is deprecated as of protocol version 2026-07-28. The server asks with a multi-round-trip request on every protocol version.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the LLM

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

tools.name: trigger-url-elicitation
tools.title: Trigger URL Elicitation Tool
tools.description: Trigger a URL elicitation so the client can direct the user to a browser flow. Supports two mechanisms: the request path (elicitation/create, default) which awaits the user's response, and the error path (UrlElicitationRequiredError, -32042) which signals the client to handle URL elicitation via the error response. Set errorPath=true to use the error path. On protocol version 2026-07-28 the server instead returns the URL elicitation in-band (input_required).

url.description: The URL the user should open

message.default: Please open the link to complete this action.
message.description: Message shown to the user before opening the URL

elicitationId.description: Optional explicit elicitation ID. Defaults to a random UUID. 2025-era clients only: the 2026-07-28 in-band request carries no elicitation ID.

errorPath.description: Controls which elicitation mechanism is used. When false (default), sends an elicitation/create request (request path). When true, throws a UrlElicitationRequiredError (MCP error code -32042) so the client handles the URL elicitation via the error path rather than waiting for a response. To clear the error, satisfy the prerequisite and retry this call with the same arguments; the retry ignores errorPath and proceeds, so the client does not loop on the same error. 2025-era clients only: protocol version 2026-07-28 has no -32042 error, so there both settings use the in-band input_required flow.
